STEP 5. Check the continuity at distributor harness side 
connector B-22.
(1) Disconnect the connector B-22 and measure at the harness 
side.
(2) Check for the continuity between terminal 4 and ground.
• Should be less than 2 ohm.
Q: Is the continuity normal?
YES : Go to Step 6.
NO : Repair harness wire between distributor connector B-
22 terminal 4 and ground because of open circuit or 
harness damage. Then confirm that the malfunction 
symptom is eliminated.
STEP 6. Check connector C-51, C-58 at ECM <M/T> or 
connector C-52, C-55 at PCM <A/T> for damage.
Q: Is the connector in good condition?
YES : Go to Step 7.
NO : Repair or replace it. Refer to GROUP 00E, Harness 
Connector Inspection (P.00E-2). Then confirm that 
the malfunction symptom is eliminated.
